    --[[
        Rolling Multi-Key + Inverse S-Box String Decryption Engine
        Decodes a single raw ciphertext string on-demand
    ]]
    local function _5enyub(raw)
        local len = #raw
        if len <= 0 then return "" end

        local keyCount = #_dnyaun
        -- Clone keys for mutation during decryption
        local keys = {}
        for ki = 1, keyCount do
            keys[ki] = _dnyaun[ki]
        end
        local rollingState = _bgbvon

        local chars = {}
        local chunks = {}
        local cIdx = 1

        for i = 1, len do
            local cipherByte = StringByte(raw, i)
            local zeroI = i - 1

            -- 1. Select primary key via rotating index
            local activeKeyIndex = (zeroI % keyCount) + 1
            local currentKey = keys[activeKeyIndex]

            -- 2. Select secondary key from offset position
            local secondaryKeyIndex = ((zeroI + 3) % keyCount) + 1
            local secondaryKey = keys[secondaryKeyIndex]

            -- 3. Subtract secondary key modularly (undo diffusion)
            local unAdded = (cipherByte - secondaryKey) % 256
            if unAdded < 0 then unAdded = unAdded + 256 end

            -- 4. Inverse S-Box substitution (undo non-linear confusion)
            local unSubstituted = _9yilt[unAdded + 1]

            -- 5. Compute position-dependent mixed mask
            local mixedMask = (currentKey + rollingState + zeroI) % 256

            -- 6. XOR with mixed mask to recover plaintext byte
            local plainByte = BitXor(unSubstituted, mixedMask)

            chars[cIdx] = StringChar(plainByte)
            cIdx = cIdx + 1

            if cIdx > 4096 then
                chunks[#chunks + 1] = TableConcat(chars)
                chars = {}
                cIdx = 1
            end

            -- 7. Roll state forward using ciphertext byte (must match encryption)
            rollingState = (rollingState + cipherByte + zeroI % keyCount + 13) % 256

            -- 8. Mutate the active key slot (must match encryption)
            keys[activeKeyIndex] = (currentKey + 7) % 256
        end
        if cIdx > 1 then
            chunks[#chunks + 1] = TableConcat(chars)
        end
        return TableConcat(chunks)
    end
